experiences.title: Waterfall & Stream Strolls
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in our private cascading waterfall and dip your feet in the crystal clear mountain stream flowing directly through the farm.

experiences.title: Family Stays
experiences.description: Bond with family members across spacious lawns, splash in the private pool, and share meals in the grand dining spaces.
experiences.highlight: Private estate exclusively for your family

experiences.title: Corporate Retreats
experiences.description: Boost team collaboration. Combine high-speed internet work sessions with outdoor stream trails, indoor games, and poolside barbecues.

experiences.title: Birthday Celebrations
experiences.description: Celebrate your special milestones in a grand setting. Custom decoration, catering, and acoustic bonfire setups can be arranged.

experiences.title: Bonfire & Movie Nights
experiences.description: Gather around the warm stone bonfire under the starlit sky, roast marshmallows, and projection-screen your favorite movies on the lawn.

experiences.title: Monsoon Escape
experiences.description: Pali transforms into a lush green heaven in the monsoons. Watch waterfalls run off surrounding hills from your cozy room.
